g.text: Three J288 segments, each on a dedicated UART, 6 Mbps
full duplex, 3.3 V, 2 Mbps, 100 Hz tick
Servo IDs are the joint's index in the firmware's JOINT_NAMES (motor-setup.md).
Each segment connector carries SIGNAL from the bridge, and +BATT and GND from the distribution board.
Segment C and the bridge link run up the neck harness: a 3-pin PH 2.0 for the segment, and a
4-pin PH 2.0 (+BATT, GND, TX, RX) for the head buck and link.
All grounds are common and return to the distribution board. Details in docs/hardware.md.
